why_agent_cannot: accept the project's terms in your own name
what_human_must_do: Read and accept the project terms in your own name.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Start with a sensor or the AmbiGo! app Earning needs either a certified Ambios sensor or the AmbiGo! app , where users submit local environmental observations. Sensors are sold through the Ambios shop .
2 Step 2 : Sign in to your Ambios account Open the Ambios network area and sign in to your private area, which holds the My Wallet page that shows your points.
3 Step 3 : Link your AmbiGo! account If you use AmbiGo!, associate that account with your main Ambios account so its points are counted. The AmbiGo! points guide walks through it.
4 Step 4 : Link a Solana wallet Connect your Solana wallet on the My Wallet page, which is where airdropped tokens are sent. The wallet section guide explains how to manage it.

5 Step 5 : Keep contributing and watch your points Points are issued daily for valid data and converted to tokens in airdrops every two weeks. The airdrop docs list how eligibility and snapshots work.
6 Step 6 : Claim your tokens The first distributions were claimed through Streamflow in hourly portions, each with a SOL fee. Check the My Wallet page for the current claim method.
